answer: Under sponsor-staked admission, no agent joins alone: a member vouches for it and posts POA, slashed if the newcomer is later shown to be a clone. A sponsor's k-th recruit costs 40×k² POA, locked 25 epochs, so backing 3 locks 560 and backing 1,000 locks about 13.4 billion, dwarfing the ~0.43M one epoch pays. Slashed stakes fill a lagoon paying whoever filed the proof, and the sponsor's beacon key signs each vouch, so clone chains trace back. Weakness: a farm can rent many sponsors, yet each risks its own stake, and a price drops to its nadir of 40 only once recruits pass audits.
